Yinyang Empty

Keep reverse alignment, Yinyang dialectics, and the formation methods; develop your own philosophy and personal version.

Empty includes the six formation guides, Core views as attributed suggestions, the practice overview, formation and revision, daily collaboration, and guidance for organizing Personal. It does not contain docs/ or diagrams/. The author's developed essays and diagrams remain in Full and on the website for optional reading.

Reverse alignment and crossed participation with dialectical return are shared core commitments of these editions. Other suggestions do not become your adopted philosophy merely because you installed the package. Your actual philosophy, personal material, and six working accounts are formed with you, from your purposes, experience, sources, and environment. The model can carry the writing and implementation; you need not do it unaided.

What you need Start here

Install and update without replacing your own content Files and updates

The references/formation/ directory contains six guides, each in English and Chinese: orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, environment, and revision. The matching actual files belong in private references/situated/. Evidence and maintained personal understanding belong in private references/personal/; your philosophical writing can stay at its existing owner or under private references/philosophy/. Empty includes four unfilled Personal areas and six Situated starter files marked status: unfilled; their existence does not mean the actual accounts have been formed. The Personal areas are preferences and selection, psychological experience and assessment, personal conditions and everyday life, and self-expression and works. Fill them from actual material with the model; no personal facts or portraits are supplied.

The Codex installation guide offers yinyang-empty@boluopai. Choose Full or Empty for the same personal version, and keep personal additions outside replaceable plugin caches. Public method updates retain your own content; they do not install Full's philosophical corpus.

This is an edition of Yinyang by boluopai, adapted by selecting its method resources and retaining developed essays as optional external reading. It retains CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Share adaptations under the same license, with attribution and changes identified; private adaptations need not be public.
